acceptanceCriteria: The freshness vocabulary in `docs/specs/external-evidence-provider-v0.md` and `internal/extevidence/freshness.go` carries the three new states with strict decode tests.
Each state is distinguishable in the impact packet output and pinned by a fixture.
body:
Filed from the audit of https://github.com/beamfall/corvint/issues/64 (generic ExternalEvidenceProvider contract) on 2026-09-22.

`internal/extevidence/freshness.go:15-19` defines only the current freshness states. Issue #64 asks for a provider observed at an ancestor of the target revision (`provider-is-ancestor`), a reference the provider cannot find (`reference-missing`) and a reference that resolves to more than one location (`reference-ambiguous`). Today those cases collapse into the nearest existing state or a refusal, so a consumer cannot tell a stale provider from a wrong reference.

completion.reason: Accepted wire names kept; issue-64 vocabulary mapped in the guide: provider-is-ancestor = repository-ahead, reference-missing = missing/deleted, not-observed = not-verified, ambiguous = identity ambiguous (EEP-V1-004). reference-ambiguous needs symbol identity and stays with V1-0101.

title: extevidence: freshness vocabulary lacks provider-is-ancestor, reference-missing and reference-ambiguous states
